summary: A wide dermatology and aesthetic range is a strength, but a New York address in the footer and a booking form that appears to have no fields cost you patients.

findings.problem: The footer says We are Here: 27 Division St, New York, NY 10002, USA, while the body lists an address in the Old Airport Area, Doha.
findings.cost: A wrong address confuses patients and hurts local search.

findings.problem: The Get in Touch section appears to show labels and a Submit button with no input fields, and Book Online sends people to a different website.
findings.cost: Patients who try to book may leave or never reach you.
findings.fix: A working booking form on your own domain.

findings.problem: The page says a filler result lasts up to two days while Botox and Profhilo last up to six months, and the clinic appears as Al Abdulla, Al-Abdulla and Al Abdullah.
findings.cost: Odd claims and changing names weaken trust in aesthetic care.
findings.fix: Checked treatment claims and one consistent name.

findings.problem: About Us links to #, Terms and Privacy both go to a contacts page, and no doctors, prices, results or reviews appear.
findings.cost: Missing proof is the main reason patients choose another clinic.

redesign: One correct address and a working booking form on your domain.
Checked treatment claims and one consistent clinic name.
Named doctors, results and patient reviews.
